pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Ugh... my head. I was in a Duel Monsters tournament a second ago.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: A portal of light opened in the middle of the arena and pulled me in.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Sand, palm trees, a river... This looks like ancient Egypt!

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Only my deck came with me. I need someone who knows the way home.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Talk to Simon Muran, the old sage waiting at the golden arena.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Strange clothes, {lad|lass}... But those cards are as old as our magic.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I fell out of a portal. Do you know how I get back to my own time?

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Maybe. Show me how you duel and I will tell you where you came from. Duel?

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Impressive! You duel like a master.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: The portal that brought you is a rift in time. Only the Time Stone can close it.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: The Stone's pieces lie beyond the river, to the north. I told the bridge guard.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Mystical Elf and a Canteen. Check your Backpack.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Cross the river to the north. Teana and Jono want a duel too.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Not bad, but you need more practice. Rest and try again.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: The bridge is up the road to the north. Good luck, traveler.

pages.speaker: teana
pages.text: Hi! Are you the stranger who beat Simon? Duel me?

pages.speaker: teana
pages.text: Wow, you're really good! Take this card.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Feral Imp.

pages.speaker: jono
pages.text: Hey, rookie! I bet my deck is stronger. Duel?

pages.speaker: jono
pages.text: Fine, fine... you won. Here, it's yours.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Baby Dragon.

pages.speaker: teana
pages.text: Hehe, I won! Come back anytime.

pages.speaker: jono
pages.text: Ha! Train some more and come back.

pages.speaker: teana
pages.text: Old Simon is waiting for you at the arena.

pages.speaker: jono
pages.text: Talk to Simon first, then we duel.

pages.speaker: guard
pages.text: Halt! Nobody crosses the river without the sage Simon Muran's permission.

pages.speaker: guard
pages.text: Simon allowed it? Then you may pass, traveler.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The Royal City is far to the north. First I have to get past these ruins.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 1
pages.text: Chapter 2 - Sand Ruins

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Broken columns, an obelisk... and a glowing stone portal in the back!

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: There are people here. Those two are from the tournament! Did they fall into the past too?

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Beat Rex Raptor and Weevil. Then enter the stone portal to the north.

pages.speaker: teana
pages.text: Safe travels, stranger!

pages.speaker: jono
pages.text: Next time I win!

pages.speaker: rex
pages.text: You fell here too? Great. Beating you puts me closer to going home.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then let's duel. The winner gets a clear path.

pages.speaker: rex
pages.text: My dinosaurs will crush you! Duel?

pages.speaker: rex
pages.text: I can't believe it... I lost to a rookie!

pages.speaker: rex
pages.text: Here, I found this shiny stone in the ruins. Maybe it helps you.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got Time Stone Fragment 1 and the card Ryu-kishin.

pages.speaker: rex
pages.text: Hahaha! Come back when you have real dinosaurs.

pages.speaker: weevil
pages.text: Hehehe. In this world nobody checks if we cheat.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then I'll win the right way, so you remember it.

pages.speaker: weevil
pages.text: My bugs disagree. Duel?

pages.speaker: weevil
pages.text: Impossible! My strategy was perfect!

pages.speaker: weevil
pages.text: Fine, fine... take this old torch and leave me alone.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got a Torch and the card Hitotsu-me Giant.

pages.speaker: weevil
pages.text: Hehehe! I knew you'd fall into my trap.

pages.speaker: rex
pages.text: Go on to the portal. I will still get my rematch.

pages.speaker: weevil
pages.text: Hmpf. Get lost before I change my mind.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The portal does not react. I think I must beat Rex and Weevil first.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The portal glows brighter now. I'm going in!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 2
pages.text: Chapter 3 - The Palace and the Prince

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Wow! The portal took me inside the Royal City. What a huge palace!

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: In front of the palace stand a priest and a young man who looks like a king. The Prince!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Talk to the priest Seto in front of the palace.

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: A stranger with cards nobody knows. Are you a threat or a gift?

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Seto, let him prove himself. If he loses, I will send him away myself.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: If I win, I want to know why these time rifts keep opening.

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: Agreed. Prepare your deck. Duel?

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: Hmpf... you won. If the Prince trusts you, so will I.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: The rifts began when the priest Heishin opened the vault of the Millennium Items.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Take the Royal Seal. It opens the palace, so you can find out what Heishin wants.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Royal Seal and the card Dark Magician.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Enter the palace and investigate Heishin. The Mage Soldier offers a duel.

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: That was it? Come back when you are ready, stranger.

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: The palace is open to you. Do not disappoint me.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Welcome to the Royal City, traveler. Show Seto what you can do.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Beware of Heishin. He roams the palace halls at night.

pages.speaker: mage_soldier
pages.text: I train the palace guards. Want to test your deck against me? Duel?

pages.speaker: mage_soldier
pages.text: Good duel! Take this card on your journey.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Celtic Guardian.

pages.speaker: mage_soldier
pages.text: Train a bit more and come back.

pages.speaker: mage_soldier
pages.text: The guards speak highly of you.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The palace door is shut. I need Seto's permission first.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: With the Royal Seal the door opened. Heishin is hiding something in here.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 3
pages.text: Chapter 4 - Heishin's Coup

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: That Night
pages.text: Heishin attacked the city with his guards. The sky turned red with fire.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: This is the throne hall! Heishin is up on the throne and the Prince is surrounded!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Defeat Heishin in the throne hall.

pages.speaker: heishin
pages.text: The Millennium Items give power to those with the courage to take them. And I had it.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: You attacked the whole city for seven pieces of gold?

pages.speaker: heishin
pages.text: For seven keys. And now you hand me your deck. Duel?

pages.speaker: heishin
pages.text: Impossible! A stranger beat me? This is not over!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: What Happened
pages.text: Heishin fled through the window and took the Millennium Items with him.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: {name}! Heishin will come back for the Prince. There is only one way to protect him.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: I will keep the Prince's soul in the Millennium Puzzle. He sleeps until the time is right.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: {name}, I trust you. Find the Items and wake me when the time comes.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Take the Millennium Necklace. It shows the future and can open a rift to your time.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Necklace and the card Gaia the Fierce Knight.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Touch the glowing throne to travel through time.

pages.speaker: heishin
pages.text: Hahaha! Too weak. Come back when you have real courage.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: {name}! Heishin wants the Millennium Items. Please, stop him!

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: I protect the Prince. Go, stranger, face Heishin!

pages.speaker: seto
pages.text: The Prince is kept in the Puzzle. Find the Items and bring him back.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The throne is not glowing. I must defeat Heishin first.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The Necklace is glowing with the throne. A time rift is opening!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 4
pages.text: Chapter 5 - The Tournament Out of Time

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Wait... this is Pegasus's tournament island! Did I come back to my own time?

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: No... the sky still has rifts. The tournament got stuck between two eras.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Beat Mai, Bandit Keith and Shadi. Then face Pegasus in front of the castle.

pages.speaker: mai
pages.text: Honey, strategy is what counts here. And a little perfume.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then let's see which strategy is better.

pages.speaker: mai
pages.text: My Harpies are ready. Duel?

pages.speaker: mai
pages.text: Not bad, honey. You won fair and square.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Harpie Lady.

pages.speaker: mai
pages.text: Hihi, come back when you learn to play.

pages.speaker: mai
pages.text: Good luck with Pegasus. He is very weird.

pages.speaker: keith
pages.text: This tournament is mine. You're just another name on my list.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then try to cross my name out, if you can.

pages.speaker: keith
pages.text: We'll see, rookie. Duel?

pages.speaker: keith
pages.text: Grr... beginner's luck!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Great White.

pages.speaker: keith
pages.text: Hah! Go home, rookie.

pages.speaker: keith
pages.text: Don't talk to me now, rookie.

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: I am Shadi, guardian of the Millennium Items. I see you carry the Necklace.

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: Show me that your heart is worthy of it. Duel?

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: Your heart is pure. Take this piece of the Time Stone.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got Time Stone Fragment 2 and the card Illusionist Faceless Mage.

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: Your heart still holds doubts. Come back later.

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: Pegasus has the Millennium Eye. Be careful with him.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Hello, {name}-{boy|girl}! First beat the other three duelists. Then I duel you.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: I already read your fate, {name}-{boy|girl}. Why not find out if I am right?

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Nobody reads my fate. I write it in the duel!

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: How fun! Duel?

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Impossible! The Millennium Eye could not read your mind!

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Keep the Eye. Maybe it will help you save the Prince.

pages.speaker: isis
pages.text: I am Isis. I saw you in a vision. I will open a portal back to Egypt.

pages.speaker: isis
pages.text: The Temple Mages guard the other Items. The Prince needs them.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Eye and the card Thousand Dragon.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Enter the castle portal to return to Egypt.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Hahaha! I told you I had read your fate.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Isis's portal is open at the castle. Goodbye, {name}-{boy|girl}!

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The castle gate is shut. I have to beat Pegasus first.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Isis's portal is open. Time to go back to Egypt!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 5
pages.text: Chapter 6 - The Seven Items

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Hot sand again! The portal dropped me at an old crossroads.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: {name}! Isis sent word that you were coming. I kept the Puzzle safe.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Puzzle. The Prince sleeps inside it.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Heishin only emptied the vault. The real Items were hidden in five temples.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Each temple has a Mage who guards one. Beat the Mages and they will let you take it.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Sea, forest, mountain, desert and meadow. Got it. Let's go.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Visit the five temples and win their Items. Then open the Labyrinth gate.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Heishin's men were seen near the temples. Hurry, but do not rush your duels.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: You have all five Items! Go to the Labyrinth gate. I will guard the crossroads.

pages.speaker: ocean_mage
pages.text: Halt, stranger! The sea does not open its temple to dry-footed visitors.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I only want to borrow what the temple guards. Duel me.

pages.speaker: ocean_mage
pages.text: The tide will decide. Duel?

pages.speaker: ocean_mage
pages.text: The tide has turned... Go in. High Mage Secmeton waits inside.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Aqua Dragon.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Enter the Sea Temple and face High Mage Secmeton.

pages.speaker: ocean_mage
pages.text: The sea washes you back to shore. Try again.

pages.speaker: ocean_mage
pages.text: Secmeton waits inside. The sea lets you pass.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: A wall of water blocks the inner door. The Ocean Mage must let me in first.

pages.speaker: secmeton
pages.text: So you are the one who walks through time. The waters whispered about you.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then you know why I am here. I need the Sea Tablet.

pages.speaker: secmeton
pages.text: Words are shallow. Show me with cards. Duel?

pages.speaker: secmeton
pages.text: You swim well, traveler. The Sea Tablet is yours.

pages.speaker: secmeton
pages.text: It fits the Labyrinth gate. Heishin's men want it badly.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Sea Tablet and the card Suijin.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Four temples remain - Forest, Mountain, Desert and Meadow.

pages.speaker: secmeton
pages.text: Too shallow. Dive deeper and come back.

pages.speaker: secmeton
pages.text: Guard the Tablet well. The sea remembers.

pages.speaker: anubisius
pages.text: Quiet, stranger. The old trees do not like noise.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I came for the Millennium Key. The Prince's life is at stake.

pages.speaker: anubisius
pages.text: The forest gives nothing for free. Duel?

pages.speaker: anubisius
pages.text: The roots yield to you. Take the Millennium Key.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Key and the card Ancient One of the Deep Forest.

pages.speaker: anubisius
pages.text: The forest swallowed your cards. Try again.

pages.speaker: anubisius
pages.text: The Key is in good hands. The trees approve.

pages.speaker: atenza
pages.text: The path is steep and so is my price. Only the strong may take the Rod.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I came through time. A mountain will not stop me.

pages.speaker: atenza
pages.text: Then climb! Duel?

pages.speaker: atenza
pages.text: You reached the peak. The Millennium Rod is yours.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Rod and the card Thunder Dragon.

pages.speaker: atenza
pages.text: The mountain is cold and so am I. Climb again.

pages.speaker: atenza
pages.text: Use the Rod wisely. Power is not wisdom.

pages.speaker: martis
pages.text: The sand buries those who rush. Slow down, time traveler.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Slow down? I just crossed five thousand years.

pages.speaker: martis
pages.text: Then let the dunes judge you. Duel?

pages.speaker: martis
pages.text: The dunes bow to you. Take the Millennium Ring.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Ring and the card Mystical Sand.

pages.speaker: martis
pages.text: The sand covers your footprints. Come back.

pages.speaker: martis
pages.text: Heishin's men came by. They left empty-handed.

pages.speaker: kepura
pages.text: Welcome to the meadow, little traveler! The flowers said you were coming.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Flowers? ...Okay. I need the Millennium Scales.

pages.speaker: kepura
pages.text: Gently or fiercely, a duel decides. Duel?

pages.speaker: kepura
pages.text: How lovely! You duel with a kind heart. The Scales are yours.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Millennium Scales and the card Queen of Autumn Leaves.

pages.speaker: kepura
pages.text: Oh dear. Rest among the flowers, then try again.

pages.speaker: kepura
pages.text: Keep your heart balanced and the Scales will do the rest.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The gate has five empty sockets. I need the Items from all five temples.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Tablet, Key, Rod, Ring and Scales... the sockets are glowing!

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 6
pages.text: Chapter 7 - The Labyrinth and the Guardians

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The gate opens onto stairs going down into the dark. Here goes nothing.

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: Careful! I felt Heishin pass here. Seto went ahead to guard the way.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Cross the Labyrinth. Beat its guardians to reach the altar.

pages.speaker: labyrinth_mage
pages.text: A new face in the maze. Few ever walk back out.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then I will be one of the few.

pages.speaker: labyrinth_mage
pages.text: The walls shift here. So do the odds. Duel?

pages.speaker: labyrinth_mage
pages.text: You read the maze well. Take this and move on.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Guardian of the Labyrinth.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Go on to the first door and face Guardian Sebek.

pages.speaker: labyrinth_mage
pages.text: Lost already? The maze loves new faces.

pages.speaker: labyrinth_mage
pages.text: Straight on, then left. Or right. Who knows?

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The walls keep moving. The Mage who controls them must be near.

pages.speaker: sebek
pages.text: No living soul passes this door without the judgment of the gods.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then judge me.

pages.speaker: sebek
pages.text: The scales are ready. Duel?

pages.speaker: sebek
pages.text: The gods find you... acceptable. The door is open.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Guardian of the Throne Room.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Next door - Guardian Neku.

pages.speaker: sebek
pages.text: Judged and found lacking. Return when you are worthy.

pages.speaker: sebek
pages.text: Go. Neku waits at the next door.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Another door, but Sebek's judgment comes first.

pages.speaker: neku
pages.text: I am Neku, keeper of the second door. Sebek judges the body. I judge the heart.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: My heart is fine. It is the rest of me that is tired.

pages.speaker: neku
pages.text: We will see. Duel?

pages.speaker: neku
pages.text: Your heart is steady. Pass, traveler.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Rude Kaiser.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Seto stands beyond the second door.

pages.speaker: neku
pages.text: Your heart wavers. Rest, then return.

pages.speaker: neku
pages.text: Seto waits beyond. Do not keep him waiting.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: This door will not budge. I must beat Neku first.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: You came. I had my doubts.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I said I would find the Items.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: I serve the Prince, not you. But today we fight on the same side.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then why duel?

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: The altar will test you. I will not let the Prince rest in untested hands. Duel?

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: Enough. I was wrong to doubt you.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: Take the White Dragon. It chose to fight beside you.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Blue-eyes White Dragon.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Reach the altar and wake the Prince.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: Not yet. Come back stronger.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: The altar is ahead. I will guard your back.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Seto stands in front of the altar. He will not let me through yet.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Ring, Rod, Key, Scales, Necklace, Eye... and the Puzzle.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: The Altar
pages.text: The seven Items glow. The Prince's soul rises from the Puzzle.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: {name}... Seto... I heard everything in my sleep. Thank you.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: My Prince! You are free.

pages.speaker: heishin2
pages.text: Hahaha! You did the hard work for me. All seven Items in one room!

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Heishin! You never give up.

pages.speaker: heishin2
pages.text: I gave up nothing. Duel, if you dare!

pages.speaker: heishin2
pages.text: Back for more? Hand over the Items!

pages.speaker: heishin2
pages.text: No... the Items! The shadow promised me...

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: The Shadow
pages.text: Heishin fades into black smoke. Something deeper stirs below.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: That was not Heishin's own power. Something older has woken.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got Time Stone Fragment 3 and the card Summoned Skull.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Take the dark stairs behind the altar with the Prince.

pages.speaker: heishin2
pages.text: Hahaha! The Items are mine!

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Let us go. Whatever waits below, we face it together.

pages.speaker: seto2
pages.text: Heishin was a pawn. The real enemy is below. Go, I will follow.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The Fragments and the Items are all pulling toward the dark stairs.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: End of Chapter 7
pages.text: Chapter 8 - Nitemare

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: The Final Temple. It floats in the Shadow Realm.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Last duel. After this, I go home.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Reach the Final Temple and defeat Nitemare.

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: Turn back... The night does not forgive.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Seto! That is not you talking.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: The shadow holds him. Break it with a duel, {name}!

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: ...Duel.

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: Argh... what have I done? Prince?

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: I saw it. DarkNite wears Heishin's grudge. Nitemare sleeps above.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Red-eyes B. Dragon.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Beat DarkNite in the hall of shadows.

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: ...Leave. Come back stronger.

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: Go on. I will hold the door behind you.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: A wall of black mist. Seto stands in my way.

pages.speaker: darknite
pages.text: The seven Items called me. Thank you for bringing them.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: {name}, I duel beside you. This world is not only mine.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Let's finish this.

pages.speaker: darknite
pages.text: Two hearts against one night? Duel!

pages.speaker: darknite
pages.text: Impossible... the dark cannot lose to the light!

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: You amused me, DarkNite. Now step aside.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Zoa.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Climb to the top and face Nitemare.

pages.speaker: darknite
pages.text: Nothing is lost in the dark. Not even you.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: The stairs are sealed by shadow. DarkNite is guarding them.

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: I am Nitemare. I was here before the first Item.

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: Heishin was a puppet. The rifts, the Items... all of it was mine.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: You opened the rifts? You pulled me from my own time?

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: I opened every door. Close the last one yourself, if you can.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Together, {name}! Light the way through the night!

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Last duel. Then I am going home.

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: Come, then. Duel!

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: No... the light of seven Items...

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: The Time Stone
pages.text: The three Fragments fly together and form the complete Time Stone.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Time Stone and the legendary card Workers' Rights.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Objective
pages.text: Choose how your journey ends.

pages.speaker: nitemare
pages.text: The dark takes everything. Even hope.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: The Stone can send you home, {name}. Or you can stay beside us.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Use the Time Stone to go home?

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Goodbye, Seto. Goodbye, Prince. Thank you for everything.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Take this card as a memory. We will not forget you.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Mystical Elf as a keepsake.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Epilogue
pages.text: The Stone's light carries {name} back to the arena, one second after leaving.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: ...Same arena. Same crowd. And I still have the Prince's card.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: The End
pages.text: Thank you for playing JOURNEY MODE.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I think my story is here now. I will stay.

pages.speaker: seto3
pages.text: Then serve beside me, priest. The Prince will need you.

pages.speaker: prince
pages.text: Welcome home, {name}. Egypt is your time too.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Epilogue
pages.text: {name} became a priest of the Royal City and kept the Time Stone safe forever.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: The End
pages.text: Thank you for playing JOURNEY MODE.

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: Tweet-tweet! Welcome, time traveler. I am Cockatiel, wandering duelist.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Nice crest. Does your bird bite?

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: Only sore losers. My flock is eager for a duel. Ready?

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: Ha! Not bad. My flock is impressed.

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: Keep this feather. It brings luck to those who fly high.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the Cockatiel Feather and the card Crimson Sunbird.

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: Chirp! Come back after some seeds and practice.

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: Fly high, traveler. The wind remembers you.

pages.speaker: cockatiel
pages.text: I heard what you did out there. The whole flock is singing about it.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Wait... that is my face! And that looks like my deck!

pages.speaker: mirror
pages.text: I am the Atos who stayed home. The rift pulled the wrong one, or maybe the right one.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Then let's see which of us is the better duelist.

pages.speaker: mirror
pages.text: Fine by me. My deck works overtime. Duel?

pages.speaker: mirror
pages.text: Not bad... you work harder than I do.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.label: Reward
pages.text: You got the card Hero of the East.

pages.speaker: mirror
pages.text: Overtime pays off. Try again.

pages.speaker: mirror
pages.text: Go on. I will keep the arena warm.
